feature: League dock tab bar (Match/Team/Players/League/Menu)
detail: Routes exist (league-shell-ops leagueTabs/leagueMoreItems). Mobile bottom-tabs.tsx is global (Home/Lists/Players/Search/More); the league sub-nav is a horizontal scroller at the top of the page.

feature: Swap global bottom tabs for league tabs inside a league
detail: IA ruling needed on how the league dock coexists with the global mobile tabs, and what 'League' and 'Menu' map to (league home/standings; the More sheet).

feature: Dock league switcher (swipe between leagues, swipe-up Switch league sheet, toast)
detail: use-leagues.ts lists the user's leagues and use-standings.ts gives the record. No switcher, gestures or sheet exist.

feature: League header Messages icon + DM badge
detail: DMs are mock-only (rail/messages-panel.tsx, featureFlags.messages). No tables or API.

feature: Team summary PF rank / PA rank
detail: standings-service has points_for/points_against. Compute the ranks client-side.

feature: Team summary win % + win bar
detail: No win-probability model or data. WinProbMeter in league-cells.tsx is unused.

feature: Team summary card bound to real data (name, record, standing, Proj)
detail: Data exists: team-page header, useIdentity standings, projectedTotal. The prototype card is literal text.

feature: Quick action tiles Schedule/Trade/Moves
detail: The destinations exist: schedule page, tradesHref trade center, TeamTransactionsPanel. Only the tiles are new.

feature: Quick action News
detail: No player/team news feed. home/injury-news-card.tsx is mock data.

feature: Row '% rostered · % start' line
detail: my-team-ops.ts: Rostered % has no source and always reads '—'; no start % at all. Needs a cross-league aggregate. Also questionable for a small test cohort.

feature: Row game string with live/final score and clock (W 19-17, Q4 6:50, Final)
detail: nfl_games has home_score/away_score/quarter/game_clock/status, but use-nfl-week-games.ts selects only id/home/away/kickoff/status. Extend the select.

feature: Mobile stacked lineup rows (chip, headshot, name+meta with bye, OPRK, points, proj)
detail: lineup-editor.tsx StarterRow/BenchRow table → stacked rows. PositionBadge, PlayerFace, bye_week, OprkChip, box score and league_player_values all exist.

feature: Empty bench seat rows
detail: The bench renders only rostered players. Derive empty seats from roster_settings bench size minus the roster count.

feature: Swap player bottom sheet (slot-centric eligible list, selected card, Bench section, empty copy, target ring)
detail: The app uses a per-player Move dropdown + drag (lineup-editor MoveMenu, moveOptions/planMove with displacement, set_lineup autosave). Needs an inverse 'who can fill this slot' ops function over planMove plus a ui/sheet bottom variant. Locked players must stay unswappable.

feature: Bench-to-bench reorder / bench ordering
detail: The bench is an unordered set (slot_key 'bn'); no order is stored. Drop it or rule on it.

feature: Keep app-only team-page features (lineup check, matchup strip, columns, IR, drop, transactions, commissioner tools, week picker, states) in the mobile design
detail: Not in the prototype. CLAUDE.md says keep and restyle.

feature: Team avatar colours (64px team-view avatar, builder chips/heads, trade detail avatars)
detail: The teams table has no colour or avatar column; Crest shows initials on grey. Decide: derive a colour client-side, or let managers choose (new column).

feature: Team view stat tiles Record/Rank/Points for
detail: useStandings has them. The team page doesn't read standings for other teams.

feature: Team view Streak tile
detail: No streak field. Derive from use-schedule matchups (final weeks + scores).

feature: Team view Message button
detail: No DM backend (messages flag is mock).

feature: Team view Recent moves + 'No moves this season'
detail: The activity API supports team_id + type filters (api/leagues/[id]/activity). TeamTransactionsPanel is own-team only.

feature: 'See all' → league transactions filtered to a team
detail: The activity page's Adds & drops tab has no team filter in the URL (only the Commissioner tab does). The API already supports team_id.

feature: Team view layout (identity, Propose trade, read-only rows)
detail: team/[teamId] with canEdit=false. The Propose trade link exists, with the deadline/unmanaged/own-team gates. UsernameLink for @mgr.

feature: Full-screen single trade detail (league tag, title, sent time, side blocks, status pills, Receives/Sends grid)
detail: The trades list read (TradeView) has everything. Today trades render as TradeCards in trade-center.tsx with no single-trade view. @handles come from the league detail's members (TradeTeamRef has only the team name).

feature: Trade offer expiry ('expires in 2 days', 'Offer expires in' select)
detail: No per-offer expiry. Offers expire only at the trade deadline (151 'expired'). Needs a column, RPC param and tick job.

feature: Draft-pick trade assets
detail: trade_items carries players + FAAB only (148). Redraft leagues have no future picks. Product call plus new backend if wanted.

feature: Hide usernames / Hide team names screenshot toggles
detail: Client-only display toggles. No backend needed.

feature: Trade 'Message @mgr' chip and 'Send a direct message' toggle
detail: DMs don't exist. Propose already sends an in-app notification.

feature: Trade detail footers (Decline/Counter/Accept, Withdraw, finished text)
detail: TradeButtons: Turn down / Counter / Accept (+ drops gate, 162 preview, deadline) and Call off offer (real 'cancelled' status). The status set is richer than the prototype's. Review tally and commissioner actions are app-only; keep them.

feature: Notification deep link to the specific trade detail
detail: notification-href.ts routes league_trade_* to the trade center. The payload includes trade_id.

feature: Full-screen trade builder with opponent chip row and roster-grid tiles
detail: trade-builder.tsx is an inline Card with a 'Trade with' Select and a checkbox list (PlayerPickRow). Partners = managed teams only. Keep the lock notes.

feature: Builder team heads with record · rank
detail: Standings read exists; the builder doesn't use it.

feature: Builder tile player age
detail: players.birth_date exists but isn't in the rosters read. Fetch via usePlayersByIds or extend the read.

feature: Builder two-step pick → review flow with Receives/Sends chips and 'Edit players'
detail: The app is single-step with live legality preview (162). builderLegs/tradeSides provide the data.

feature: Builder footer summary (count badge, 'N for M', View proposal)
detail: Driven by builderProblem/builderGate. Keep the app's rules (one-sided offers allowed when allow_future_considerations is on). Disable the button for invalid offers instead of tapping through to a toast refusal.

feature: Keep app-only builder features (FAAB legs, drop picker, note, legality preview, deadline lock, no-partner state)
detail: Not in the prototype. Keep and restyle per CLAUDE.md.

feature: Trades listed in Messages › Trades with pending count and inline actions
detail: Trades live in league More › Trades (trade-center Pending/History) and Messages is mock. IA ruling needed on whether trades also surface in DMs.

feature: Bottom sheet shell and toast styling/timing
detail: ui/sheet.tsx side='bottom' (slides in; the spec doesn't animate). ui/toast.tsx is already an ink pill with TOAST_LIMIT=1; the toaster duration is 4500 vs the spec's ~1800 ms.

feature: Dark mode (.fs-dark variables)
detail: CLAUDE.md rules a single theme with no dark/light toggle. Don't build.
